subject: qplot barplot seems to be ignoring factor order

messages.author: 5e84f14a869dff98
messages.subject: qplot barplot seems to be ignoring factor order
parts:
I think this was discussed previously and Hadley even added to the bug list for ggplot, however, I guess I want to ask if there is a work around that works better than my example below - especially since it fails to maintain the desired factor order.

Thank you again for the feedback and insights.


Me_df<-data.frame(Data = c(1:15), Person = "Me")
You_df<-data.frame(Data = c(10:20), Person = "You")
Them_df<-data.frame(Data = c(15:25), Person = "Them")

Group_df_tmp<-rbind(Me_df,You_df)
Group_df<-rbind(Group_df_tmp,Them_df)

Group_df$Person <- factor(Group_df$Person, levels = c("Them", "You", "Me"))

counts <- ddply(Group_df, .(cut(Data, breaks=fullseq(range(Data), 5)), Person), nrow)
names(counts) <- c("Bin", "Person", "Frequency")
qplot(Person, Frequency, data = counts, fill = Person, geom="bar", stat="identity", width = 0.9, xlab="Person") + facet_grid(. ~ Bin)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: qplot barplot seems to be ignoring factor order
parts:
One work around is to manually specify the order:

+ xlim("Me", "You", "Them")

Hadley

messages.subject: Re: qplot barplot seems to be ignoring factor order
parts:
Awesome! This is great!

Is there anyway to get the order in the legend to match the order specified in the xlim?

It looks like the legend keeps using the old order of the text, i.e. the order is the same as without the xlim().

It would be great if the order in the legend matched the order of the xlim().

Thank you again for all your insights.

Me_df<-data.frame(Data = c(1:15), Person = "Me")
You_df<-data.frame(Data = c(10:20), Person = "You")
Them_df<-data.frame(Data = c(15:25), Person = "Them")

Group_df_tmp<-rbind(Me_df,You_df)
Group_df<-rbind(Group_df_tmp,Them_df)

Group_df$Person <- factor(Group_df$Person, levels = c("Them", "You", "Me"))

counts <- ddply(Group_df, .(cut(Data, breaks=fullseq(range(Data), 5)), Person), nrow)
names(counts) <- c("Bin", "Person", "Frequency")
qplot(Person, Frequency, data = counts, fill = Person, geom="bar", stat="identity", width = 0.9, xlab="Person") +

facet_grid(. ~ Bin) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("royalblue2", "tomato3", "palegreen2")) + opts(legend.position=c(0.8,0.70)) + xlim("You", "Me", "Them")


Sorry for all the posts. I just got a chance to get back to some real work with ggplot2.

Thanks again.
